name: Bootstrapper
description: Lightens Roblox clients for running many accounts: limits the clients opened while it's on, except the focused one, with a profile: CPU cap, RAM cap, CPU cores, CPU and GPU priority, efficiency mode, and memory priority, and can set the frame rate cap, graphics level, and volume through Roblox's own settings. Can show where each joined server is, looked up on ipinfo.io. Windows only. Reads the Roblox logs on this device to match clients to accounts and sends only server addresses to ipinfo.io, while server location is on.
